title: A fixed-conversion quanto call
prompt: All figures and markets in this question are synthetic. The contract pays a fixed USD-per-EUR conversion factor times max(S_EUR(T)-K,0) in USD. Under the USD pricing measure, foreign-equity lognormal drift is rEUR-q-rho*sigmaS*sigmaFX; its volatility is sigmaS. Discount the USD payoff at rUSD. Parameters remain fixed if spot FX changes. Return quanto price, price at zero correlation, derivative of price with respect to correlation, and instantaneous spot-FX delta while foreign-equity spot and all other inputs stay fixed.

outputs.name: zero_correlation_price
outputs.description: PV with only rho changed to zero.

outputs.name: correlation_derivative
outputs.description: Local sensitivity to one unit of correlation.

outputs.name: spot_fx_delta
outputs.description: Derivative with respect to current USD/EUR spot, all stated inputs fixed.

instructions: Solve the synthetic quantitative-finance question using its supplied inputs and conventions. A calculator or local code is allowed. External market data is unnecessary.
